title: Macy’s Shoplifter Meets Police K9
description:
On April 4th, 2023, officers responded to a robbery at a Macy’s store. Three suspects were caught stealing clothes, and when an employee tried to stop them, they pepper-sprayed him in the face before fleeing in their car. Shortly after, they were stopped by an officer, but the suspects fled, crashing their vehicle into oncoming traffic and then escaping on foot. This is where the suspects hit another car, abandoned their vehicle, and then started running. The car they hit contained two adults and a minor female. One of the suspects did not run and remained sitting in the car. Shortly after, a K9 spotted the minor suspect hiding in the bushes and bit her.  The male's parents arrived at the scene to ask about his well-being. The minor was charged with resisting arrest and was taken to a juvenile facility, while the other female faced charges of fleeing, resisting arrest, and robbery. The male was also under consideration for robbery charges, depending on the evidence collected against him.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
